lines: Somebody from the Concord copied out nine years of my marks last week.
Very polite. Asked if I'd consider stopping. Said the record wasn't informative.
I marked it again this morning. Same line. Ninety-four days.
I mark the high tide on that post every morning. Nine years running.
The mark hasn't moved since the first week of spring.
Not higher. Not lower. The same line, ninety-odd days.
The sea does not do that on its own.
